name: Honkai: Star Rail - To Roll the Stars in Astropolis
storyline: What price must be paid to keep the arcadia breathing? What tone must resound to catch Amber's downcast eyes? The balance has silently aligned, and you are left with nothing but a final, desperate gamble.
summary:
Version 4.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Robin • Summeretto and Aventurine • Waveflair
• New Trailblaze Mission: "To Roll the Stars in Astropolis"
• New Trailblaze Continuance Mission: "How to Lose Your Way to the Top: The Zero-Dollar Strategy"
• New events
• ...and more!
